rows.text: Raised full-year 2026 adjusted diluted earnings per share range by $0.10 at midpoint to $4.40 to $4.50.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share for 2026 is now expected to be in the range of $4.40 to $4.50 (versus $4.30 to $4.40 prior), assuming a share count of approximately 56 million for full-year 2026.
